method.distance: equal-weight Gower on two survey-ordered responses

names.1: Useful employment contacts, partial institutional belonging
names.2: Strong institutional belonging, mixed employment contacts
names.3: Weak employment contacts, limited institutional belonging

decision.exclusion_reason: relatedness_at_institution is retained in the theoretically grounded motivation/study-experience dimension; reusing it here would double-count it
decision.status: Excluded from final dimension set despite statistical stability: relatedness_at_institution overlaps with the motivation/study-experience dimension

limitations: These profiles are exploratory social-response patterns, not a validated social-capital or belonging scale.
Employment contacts indicate network resources; institutional belonging is a related but distinct social condition.
Ordinal Gower positions preserve only the questionnaire's explicit order and must not be interpreted as interval-scale psychological scores.
Education-access pathway is descriptive only; no pathway is classified as inherently better than another.
Only two clustering variables are available, so profiles are narrow connectedness patterns rather than whole-person youth types.
